actions.summary: With no Texas state guidance, El Paso ISD wrote its own AI policy and El Paso-area districts have adopted classroom tools such as PowerBuddy and MagicSchool AI alongside AI-literacy lessons.
actions.notes: Carried over from the TX state profile's free-text note. effective_from is the date of the El Paso Matters coverage, not a board adoption date; the specific adopting authority and date are unverified - firm up from the district's board minutes. Enrollment figure is approximate.

actions.authority: state-appointed superintendent (Mike Miles) and board of managers
actions.summary: Opened nine AI-focused 'Future 2' campuses (five elementary, four middle) for 2026-27 - core subjects in AI-supported morning blocks, afternoons for 'human-centric' skills - and piloted Alpha School's AI-driven program at two elementary campuses. Families may opt out by transferring.
actions.notes: Miles has described a goal of up to 100 AI-focused campuses. The Alpha School pilot (Gregg and Martinez elementaries) drew separate coverage in August 2026. effective_from is the approximate first day of the 2026-27 year. Enrollment figure is approximate.

actions.authority: board policy regulations (EIA, FNCA) amended; superintendent-adopted handbook
actions.summary: Adopted 'Artificial Intelligence in Dallas ISD: A Playbook for Responsible and Innovative Use' and folded AI expectations into the grading (EIA) and student-conduct (FNCA) regulations - AI as a learning tool, original-work expectations, AI-enabled cyberbullying addressed.
actions.notes: Guidelines are written for grades 9-12. Follows a March 2025 board briefing on AI integration. Enrollment figure is approximate.
